indexes.unused_indexes: SELECT u.object_schema AS `Database Name`, u.object_name AS `Table Name`, u.index_name AS `Index Name`, ROUND((stat.stat_value * @@innodb_page_size) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS `Index Size (MB)` FROM sys.schema_unused_indexes u JOIN mysql.innodb_index_stats stat ON u.object_schema = stat.database_name AND u.object_name = stat.table_name AND u.index_name = stat.index_name WHERE stat.stat_name = 'size' AND u.object_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY `Index Size (MB)` DESC;
indexes.redundant_indexes: SELECT r.table_schema AS `Database Name`, r.table_name AS `Table Name`, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.redundant_index_name ORDER BY r.redundant_index_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Redundant Indexes List`, MAX(r.dominant_index_name) AS `Primary Index`, MAX(r.redundant_index_columns) AS `Indexed Columns` FROM sys.schema_redundant_indexes r WHERE r.table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') GROUP BY r.table_schema, r.table_name, r.redundant_index_columns ORDER BY r.table_schema, r.table_name;
indexes.queries_high_full_table_scans: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS `Database Name`, DIGEST_TEXT AS `SQL Query`, COUNT_STAR AS `Execution Count`, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000000, 2) AS `Total Latency (Seconds)`, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Average Latency (ms)`, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS `Full Table Scans Count`, SUM_NO_GOOD_INDEX_USED AS `Suboptimal Index Scans`, ROUND((SUM_NO_INDEX_USED / COUNT_STAR) * 100, 2) AS `Full Scan Percentage`, FIRST_SEEN AS `First Seen At`, LAST_SEEN AS `Last Seen At` FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_NO_INDEX_USED DESC, SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;
indexes.low_selectivity_indexes: SELECT s.TABLE_SCHEMA AS `Database Name`, s.TABLE_NAME AS `Table Name`, s.INDEX_NAME AS `Index Name`, s.COLUMN_NAME AS `Column Name`, s.CARDINALITY AS `Unique Values Count`, t.TABLE_ROWS AS `Total Table Rows`, ROUND((s.CARDINALITY / NULLIF(t.TABLE_ROWS, 0)) * 100, 2) AS `Selectivity Percentage` FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS s JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t ON s.TABLE_SCHEMA = t.TABLE_SCHEMA AND s.TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME WHERE s.TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND s.INDEX_NAME != 'PRIMARY' AND t.TABLE_ROWS > 0 HAVING `Selectivity Percentage` < 10.00 ORDER BY `Selectivity Percentage` ASC LIMIT 10;

users.account_password_hygiene: SELECT user AS `Username`, host AS `Connection Host`, plugin AS `Authentication Plugin`, account_locked AS `Is Account Locked`, password_expired AS `Is Password Expired`, password_last_changed AS `Password Last Changed At`, password_lifetime AS `Password Validity (Days)`, CASE WHEN authentication_string = '' OR authentication_string IS NULL THEN 'NO PASSWORD' WHEN password_lifetime IS NULL AND @@global.default_password_lifetime = 0 THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES (Global)' WHEN password_lifetime = 0 THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES (User-Level)' ELSE 'POLICY ENFORCED' END AS `Security Risk Status` FROM mysql.user WHERE user NOT IN ('mysql.sys', 'mysql.session', 'mysql.infoschema') AND user NOT LIKE 'cloudsql%' ORDER BY `Security Risk Status` DESC LIMIT 10;
users.excessive_administrative_privileges: SELECT GRANTEE AS `Account Name`, PRIVILEGE_TYPE AS `Privilege Granted`, IS_GRANTABLE AS `Can Grant To Others` FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USER_PRIVILEGES WHERE PRIVILEGE_TYPE IN ('SUPER', 'ALL PRIVILEGES', 'GRANT OPTION', 'SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN', 'RELOAD', 'SHUTDOWN') AND GRANTEE NOT LIKE "'mysql.%'" AND GRANTEE NOT LIKE "'root'@'localhost'" AND GRANTEE NOT LIKE "'cloudsql%'" ORDER BY `Account Name` LIMIT 10;

performance.full_table_scans: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS `Database Name`, DIGEST_TEXT AS `SQL Query`, COUNT_STAR AS `Execution Count`, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000000, 2) AS `Total Latency (Seconds)`, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Average Latency (ms)`, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS `Full Table Scans Count`, SUM_NO_GOOD_INDEX_USED AS `Suboptimal Index Scans`, ROUND((SUM_NO_INDEX_USED / COUNT_STAR) * 100, 2) AS `Full Scan Percentage`, FIRST_SEEN AS `First Seen At`, LAST_SEEN AS `Last Seen At` FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_NO_INDEX_USED DESC LIMIT 15;
performance.temp_table_usage: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS `Database Name`, DIGEST_TEXT AS `SQL Query`, COUNT_STAR AS `Execution Count`, SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES AS `Total Memory Temp Tables`, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS `Total Disk Temp Tables`, ROUND((SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES / NULLIF(SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES, 0)) * 100, 2) AS `Disk Spill Percentage`, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Average Latency (ms)`, LAST_SEEN AS `Last Seen At` FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE LAST_SEEN >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND SUM_CREATED_TMP_TABLES > 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES DESC LIMIT 15;
performance.buffer_pool_hit_ratio: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests') AS `Total Memory Read Requests`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') AS `Physical Disk Reads`, ROUND((1 - ((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'))) * 100, 2) AS `Buffer Pool Hit Percentage`;
performance.dirty_pages: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') AS `Modified Pages Count`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') AS `Total Pages Allocated`, ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') * 100, 2) AS `Dirty Pages Percentage`;
performance.redo_log: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_waits') AS `Redo Log Waits Count`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_write_requests') AS `Memory Write Requests`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_log_writes') AS `Physical Disk Writes`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_os_log_fsyncs') AS `Total Disk Syncs`;
performance.top_queries_by_execution_time: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS `Database Name`, DIGEST_TEXT AS `SQL Query`, COUNT_STAR AS `Execution Count`, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Total Execution Time (ms)`, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Average Execution Time (ms)`, ROUND((SUM_TIMER_WAIT / (SELECT SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT) FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys') AND SCHEMA_NAME IS NOT NULL)) * 100, 2) AS `Percentage Of Total DB Time`, SUM_ROWS_SENT AS `Total Rows Returned` FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND SCHEMA_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%performance_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%information_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE 'SHOW%' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE 'SET %' AND DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '/*!%' ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;

locks.lock_waits: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA AS `Database Name`, OBJECT_NAME AS `Table Name`, COUNT_STAR AS `Total Lock Incidents`, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Total Waiting Time (ms)`, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Average Waiting Time (ms)`, ROUND(MAX_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2) AS `Max Waiting Time (ms)` FROM performance_schema.table_lock_waits_summary_by_table WHERE SUM_TIMER_WAIT > 0 AND OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 15;

connections.connections_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Max_used_connections') AS `Peak Concurrent Connections`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'max_connections') AS `Allowed Max Connections`, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Max_used_connections') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'max_connections')) * 100, 2) AS `Connection Utilization Percentage`;
connections.thread_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_cached') AS `Reusable Cached Threads`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_created') AS `Total New Threads Created`, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_created') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS `Thread Cache Miss Percentage`;
connections.aborted_connections_metrics: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects') AS `Auth Failures Count`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_clients') AS `Network Drops Count`, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections') AS `Total Connection Attempts`, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS `Auth Failure Percentage`, ROUND(((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_clients') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connections')) * 100, 2) AS `Network Drop Percentage`;

storage.table_fragmentation_status: SELECT table_schema AS `Database Name`, table_name AS `Table Name`, ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS `Actual Data Size (MB)`, ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS `Index Size (MB)`, ROUND(data_free / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS `Wasted Fragmented Space (MB)`, ROUND((data_free / NULLIF(data_length + index_length + data_free, 0)) * 100, 2) AS `Fragmentation Percentage` FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND data_free > 0 ORDER BY `Wasted Fragmented Space (MB)` DESC LIMIT 15;

indexes.unused_indexes: SELECT s.schemaname AS "Database Name", s.relname AS "Table Name", s.indexrelname AS "Index Name", pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid)) AS "Formatted Index Size", s.idx_scan AS "Usage Count" FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s WHERE s.idx_scan = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = s.indexrelid AND (i.indisprimary OR i.indisunique)) AND s.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') ORDER BY pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) DESC LIMIT 10;
indexes.redundant_indexes: SELECT a.schemaname AS "Database Name", a.tablename AS "Table Name", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.indexname, ', ' ORDER BY a.indexname) AS "Redundant Indexes List", b.indexname AS "Primary Index", a.indexdef AS "Indexed Columns" FROM pg_indexes a JOIN pg_indexes b ON a.tablename = b.tablename AND a.indexname <> b.indexname AND a.schemaname = b.schemaname WHERE position(replace(a.indexdef, a.indexname, '') IN replace(b.indexdef, b.indexname, '')) > 0 AND a.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') GROUP BY a.schemaname, a.tablename, b.indexname, a.indexdef ORDER BY a.tablename;
indexes.queries_high_full_table_scans: SELECT relname AS "Table Name", seq_scan AS "Full Table Scans Count", seq_tup_read AS "Total Rows Scanned", CASE WHEN seq_scan = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((seq_tup_read::numeric / seq_scan), 0) END AS "Average Rows Per Scan", idx_scan AS "Index Scans Count", pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS "Formatted Table Size" FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE seq_scan > 0 ORDER BY seq_scan DESC LIMIT 10;
indexes.low_selectivity_indexes: SELECT database_name AS "Database Name", table_name AS "Table Name", column_name AS "Column Name", distinct_values AS "Unique Values Count", correlation AS "Data Correlation", estimated_selectivity_pct AS "Selectivity Percentage" FROM (SELECT s.schemaname AS database_name, s.tablename AS table_name, s.attname AS column_name, s.n_distinct AS distinct_values, s.correlation, CASE WHEN s.n_distinct > 0 THEN ROUND(((s.n_distinct / GREATEST(c.reltuples, 1)) * 100)::numeric, 2) WHEN s.n_distinct < 0 THEN ROUND((ABS(s.n_distinct) * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS estimated_selectivity_pct FROM pg_stats s JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = s.tablename JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = s.schemaname WHERE s.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND c.reltuples > 1000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes i WHERE i.tablename = s.tablename AND i.schemaname = s.schemaname AND position(s.attname IN i.indexdef) > 0)) sub WHERE estimated_selectivity_pct < 5 ORDER BY estimated_selectivity_pct ASC LIMIT 10;

users.account_password_hygiene: SELECT r.rolname AS "Username", r.rolcanlogin AS "Has Login Access", r.rolsuper AS "Is Superuser", r.rolinherit AS "Inherits Privileges", r.rolcreatedb AS "Can Create Databases", r.rolcreaterole AS "Can Create Roles", r.rolvaliduntil AS "Password Expiration Date", CASE WHEN r.rolvaliduntil IS NULL THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES' WHEN r.rolvaliduntil < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'POLICY ENFORCED' END AS "Security Risk Status" FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND r.rolname NOT LIKE 'cloudsql%' AND r.rolcanlogin = true ORDER BY "Security Risk Status" DESC LIMIT 10;
users.excessive_administrative_privileges: SELECT grantee AS "Account Name", table_catalog AS "Database Name", privilege_type AS "Privilege Granted", is_grantable AS "Can Grant To Others" FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE privilege_type IN ('DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER') AND grantee NOT IN ('postgres') AND grantee NOT LIKE 'cloudsql%' ORDER BY grantee LIMIT 10;

performance.buffer_pool_hit_ratio: SELECT relname AS "Table Name", heap_blks_read AS "Disk Blocks Read", heap_blks_hit AS "Memory Blocks Hit", CASE WHEN (heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((heap_blks_hit::numeric / (heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read)) * 100, 2) END AS "Buffer Hit Percentage" FROM pg_statio_user_tables WHERE (heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read) > 0 ORDER BY "Buffer Hit Percentage" ASC LIMIT 10;
performance.dirty_pages: SELECT c.relname AS "Table Name", pg_size_pretty(count(*) * 8192) AS "Formatted Dirty Data Size", count(*) AS "Dirty Pages Count", round(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM pg_buffercache WHERE isdirty), 0), 2) AS "Percentage Of Total Dirty Pages" FROM pg_buffercache b JOIN pg_class c ON b.relfilenode = pg_relation_filenode(c.oid) JOIN pg_database d ON (b.reltablespace = d.dattablespace OR b.reltablespace = 0) AND d.datname = current_database() WHERE b.isdirty = true AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'm') GROUP BY c.relname ORDER BY "Dirty Pages Count" DESC;
performance.redo_log: SELECT pg_current_wal_lsn() AS "Current WAL Position", pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), '0/0') AS "Total WAL Bytes Written", pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), '0/0')) AS "Formatted Total WAL Size", (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_ls_waldir()) AS "WAL Files Count", pg_size_pretty((SELECT sum(size) FROM pg_ls_waldir())) AS "Formatted WAL Directory Size";
performance.temp_table_usage: SELECT datname AS "Database Name", temp_files AS "Temp Files Created Count", pg_size_pretty(temp_bytes) AS "Formatted Temp Data Written", deadlocks AS "Deadlocks Count", conflicts AS "Conflicts Count" FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();
performance.top_queries_by_execution_time: SELECT query AS "SQL Query", calls AS "Execution Count", ROUND(total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS "Total Execution Time (ms)", ROUND(mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS "Average Execution Time (ms)", ROUND((100 * total_exec_time / SUM(total_exec_time) OVER())::numeric, 2) AS "Percentage Of Total DB Time", rows AS "Total Rows Processed" FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE query NOT ILIKE '%pg_catalog%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%information_schema%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_class%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_namespace%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_buffercache%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%Cloud_SQL_Studio%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%autovacuum%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_available_extensions%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_settings%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_database%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%ANALYZE%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_indexes%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_roles%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_locks%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_statio%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_ls_waldir%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_current_wal%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%role_table_grants%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%heartbeat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%google_insights%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%cloudsql_stat%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_is_in_recovery%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%password_validation%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%brute_force%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%ALTER ROLE%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%SHOW max_connections%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%validate_password%' AND query NOT ILIKE '%cloudsqladmin%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 15;

locks.lock_waits: SELECT blocked.pid AS "Waiting Process ID", blocked.usename AS "Waiting User", blocked.application_name AS "Waiting Application", blocked.query AS "Waiting SQL Query", blocking.pid AS "Blocking Process ID", blocking.usename AS "Blocking User", blocking.query AS "Blocking SQL Query", bl.locktype AS "Requested Lock Type", bl.mode AS "Requested Lock Mode", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - blocked.query_start))::int AS "Total Waiting Seconds" FROM pg_stat_activity blocked JOIN pg_locks bl ON bl.pid = blocked.pid AND NOT bl.granted JOIN pg_locks kl ON kl.granted AND kl.locktype = bl.locktype AND kl.relation = bl.relation JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking ON blocking.pid = kl.pid WHERE blocked.pid <> blocking.pid ORDER BY "Total Waiting Seconds" DESC LIMIT 10;

connections.active_connections: SELECT state AS "Connection State", count(*) AS "Active Connections Count", MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - state_change))::int) AS "Longest Connection Duration (Seconds)", (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections') AS "Allowed Max Connections", ROUND((count(*)::numeric / (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections')) * 100, 2) AS "Connection Utilization Percentage" FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state ORDER BY "Active Connections Count" DESC;
connections.aborted_connections: SELECT datname AS "Database Name", conflicts AS "Dropped Due To Conflicts", deadlocks AS "Dropped Due To Deadlocks", blk_read_time AS "Total Block Read Time (ms)", blk_write_time AS "Total Block Write Time (ms)" FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();
connections.thread_activity: SELECT state AS "Connection State", wait_event_type AS "Wait Event Category", wait_event AS "Specific Wait Event", count(*) AS "Active Threads Count" FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state, wait_event_type, wait_event ORDER BY "Active Threads Count" DESC LIMIT 10;

storage.fragmentation: SELECT schemaname AS "Database Name", relname AS "Table Name", n_live_tup AS "Active Rows Count", n_dead_tup AS "Dead Rows Count", pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS "Formatted Total Size", CASE WHEN (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((n_dead_tup::numeric / (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup)) * 100, 2) END AS "Fragmentation Percentage", last_vacuum AS "Last Manual Vacuum At", last_autovacuum AS "Last Auto Vacuum At" FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) > 0 ORDER BY "Fragmentation Percentage" DESC LIMIT 10;
